title: Dynamic investment and coordination in teams: Theory and experimental evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.13230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Teamwork requires more than the general skills that team members bring. In successful teams, members invest in team-specific skill or capital that accumulates within the team and raises the return to coordinated production. We provide the first systematic analysis of dynamic investment in such team skill. Adopting a dynamic game approach, we develop a novel theoretical framework where investment in team skill creates persistent benefits but is risky because the benefits depend on successful team coordination. We then take this framework to the laboratory to study empirically the factors that influence dynamic investment in team skill. We find underinvestment compared to the efficient benchmark. However, investment responds strongly to incentives, in line with specific theory-predicted patterns. Pre-registered traits (theory of mind and propensity to coordinate) predict investment and team-level efficiency. We conclude that careful design

translated_title: 团队中的动态投资与协调：理论与实验证据
translated_abstract: 团队合作所需的不仅仅是团队成员所带来的一般技能。在成功的团队中，成员会投资于团队特有的技能或资本，这些技能或资本在团队内部不断积累，并提高协调生产的回报。我们首次对这种团队技能的动态投资进行了系统性分析。采用动态博弈的方法，我们构建了一个新颖的理论框架，在该框架中，对团队技能的投资会带来持久的收益，但由于收益取决于团队能否成功协调，因而投资具有风险性。随后，我们将该框架引入实验室，实证研究影响团队技能动态投资的因素。研究发现，与效率基准相比，团队存在投资不足的现象。然而，投资对激励的反应非常强烈，且符合理论所预测的特定模式。预先注册的个体特质（心智理论和协调倾向）能够预测投资水平以及团队层面的效率。我们由此得出结论，精心的设计……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了团队技能动态投资的首个动态博弈理论框架，并通过实验室实验发现：团队相较于效率基准存在投资不足，但投资对激励反应强烈且符合理论预测模式，同时心智理论与协调倾向等个体特质可预测投资水平与团队效率。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the first dynamic game framework for investment in team-specific skill and, through laboratory experiments, finds that teams underinvest relative to the efficient benchmark, yet investment responds strongly to incentives in theory-predicted ways, with pre-registered traits (theory of mind and propensity to coordinate) predicting investment and team-level efficiency.
